facts.claim: Reverse DCF: EV $20.08bn, FCF guide $0.90bn, 9% discount rate, 3% terminal: implied FCF growth 6.4%/yr; base 'mid-single-digit' so implied_vs_base 'below'
facts.source: 10-yr UST 5.17% + Blume beta (raw 1.607 -> 1.407) x ERP 4.14% = Ke 10.99%; equity value $17.63bn; TTM FCF $904M less SBC $174M = $730M; FY26 FCF guide >$1.0bn less SBC = $826M
facts.source_value: Equity-basis implied 10-year growth: 11.7%/yr (TTM) or 10.0%/yr (guide); at 9% discount 7.5% / 5.8%. Base 6% for ten years is worth 0.75x the market value, 8% worth 0.86x. The dossier's EV basis with levered FCF, no SBC deduction and a 9% rate gives 6.4%
facts.note: Method error (EV against levered FCF, SBC not deducted, discount rate not tied to the 5.17% Treasury plus ERP) and an internal contradiction (text says in line, field says below). Programme basis: price implies 10-12% FCF growth vs a mid-single-digit base: implied_vs_base = above.

facts.claim: Scenario returns bear -5% / base +9% / bull +20% from $370.04 on FY26E adjusted EPS ~$21
facts.source_value: On the stated basis: bear (flat EPS, 14x) -7.4%, base (+9%/yr, 17.5x) +8.8%, bull (+15%/yr, 20x) +20.0%. FY26 guided EPS includes about $1.23 of one-off tariff benefit: on clean EPS of $19.77 the same assumptions give -9.2% / +6.6% / +17.6%
facts.note: Start EPS is overstated by the tariff benefit. Restated scenarios: bear -9.2%, base +6.6%, bull +17.6%.

facts.claim: Elo Touch acquisition (2025); 2023 securities class action; next earnings 3 Nov 2026
facts.source_value: 10-Q: Elo Holdings acquired 30 Sep 2025; d4 earnings date 2026-11-03 (not an estimate); litigation history not on EDGAR

facts.claim: Verdict INCLUDE-SMALL with implied below base
facts.source: corrected facts and programme rule 'INCLUDE-SMALL requires implied at or below base'
facts.source_value: Implied 10-12% vs base about 5-6%; refinancing of $2.2bn due May 2027; Q2 earnings flattered by a $73M one-off
facts.note: The dossier's evidence does not support INCLUDE-SMALL once the valuation method is corrected: verdict INCLUDE-SMALL -> WATCH.

verdict_changes.why: Programme-basis reverse DCF (Ke 10.99%, equity value $17.63bn, FCF after SBC $730-826M) implies 10-12%/yr FCF growth for ten years against the dossier's own mid-single-digit base, so implied_vs_base is above (not below); Q2 non-GAAP EPS and margin include a $73M one-off IEEPA tariff benefit and about $2.2bn of debt matures in May 2027.
